analogy.rationale: DDC inhibition blocks conversion of L-DOPA to dopamine and 5-HTP to serotonin, but these cells are not neuronal and express little DDC, so transcriptional response should be weak; other monoamine-pathway classes act on the same neurotransmitters and may show similarly limited effects in these cell lines.
